plan.title: SHG Loan Repayment Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Repayment status, overdue loans, and loan purposes in the SHG register

panels.title: Total SHG Loans Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Loans Fully Repaid (%)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Closed' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Overdue Loans (%)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Repayment Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan Amounts by Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS amount FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Loan Purposes by Amount
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The SHG loan register contains {{p1}} total loans across {{p2}}% fully repaid and {{p3}}% overdue. Agriculture and petty trade dominate loan purposes, with {{p5}} showing {{p5.y[0]}} Rs allocated to agriculture and {{p5.y[1]}} Rs to petty trade. The top 5 purposes by amount reveal {{p6}}—agriculture leads with {{p6.n[1]}} Rs, followed by housing and livestock. Overdue loans are concentrated in {{p4}} blocks, with {{p4.y[0]}} loans in the 'Overdue' category. Regular repayments suggest {{p2}}% of loans are performing well, but {{p3}}% require intervention.
